name: Dotted-eighth arena
desc: Dotted-eighth digital repeats as loud as the pick, turning picked eighths into a 16th-note pulse

refs.song: Where the Streets Have No Name
refs.why: the Edge's dotted-eighth echo over muted eighth-note picking
refs.source: Premier Guitar (Electric Etudes: U2's the Edge), 2015

notes: Little feedback and wet about level with the dry, as the lesson describes: the rhythm comes from the echo, so the playing must stay in time
